title: FrutigerAero_craft
description: This mod adds a new biome to the familiar Minecraft biome with the aesthetics of Frutiger Aero.
body:
RELEASE!!!!!!!!!!
This mod adds a new biome to the familiar Minecraft biome with the Frutiger Aero aesthetic. This biome has very light grass and lots of water.
![biome](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8030fbf72d2eb3d21a9ed87d7092fdadd6a6e854.jpeg)

There are many different structures in the biome.
Bubbles float in the air. Villages often appear in the biome![Bubble](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2c94d342c766d9475a173a24e84ccd5cd251b13f.png)


It also adds two new skyscraper structures.
![scyscaper](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/211886132b3fc1ef4652cc718f9acdf105348886.png)
I almost died while creating the mod because I choked on water, which is how the bubble idea came about in the sky and the particle effect.


In this mod you can find huge apartments in the frutiger aero style in which there are many interesting things: swimming pools, solariums, gardens and much more
In the biome, you can find a giant vial filled with water. It also contains a chest containing a special item, a magical vial that makes your jumps higher and also gives you a flat fall.


But this item breaks quickly.
The Complementary Reimagined shaders are a perfect match for the mod.
In future updates, I will add music to the biome, new buildings, and improve the biome.
